parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own XML Webhook destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-xml-webhook` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `xmls://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Four channels are available. The free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters. The `gateway` and `gateway-plus` channels skip Apprise: the gateway transforms the envelope into the channel-native XML body and POSTs it directly to your webhook. Pricing: the `gateway` channel is free (direct to your XML webhook, no Apprise); the `gateway-plus` channel is $0.001 per message for extra per-enrollment XML webhook destinations, delivered direct.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment XML webhook destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your XML webhook (no Apprise)

host_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's XML Webhook host (apprise-plus) or full webhook URL (gateway-plus)
